messages:
anna (cs): FYI — Acme reports that managers in their org see empty charts in Console > Analytics. Admins and owners see data fine. They hit this after a billing plan change yesterday.

maria (support): thanks — can you paste the screenshot and the exact URL? also any error from the browser console or network tab?

anna (cs): screenshot pasted. URL: https://console.redwood.ai/orgs/acme/analytics/usage?role=manager . Customer says chart shows 'No data in range' even when date range set to 30d. No JS errors. They did see 200 on the /metrics endpoint but empty series returned.

kevin (product): @jess tagging eng-ml because this smells like a permissions+retention join. did we recently change role-based filtering on the metrics pipeline?

jess (eng-ml): I pushed a small change last week related to TTL enforcement for linked orgs (https://gh.redwood/infra/metrics#PR-1123). It tightened the retention join so only rows with metrics.retention_expires > now() are counted. Might be interacting with role mapping.

aj (eng-sre): can you share a repro query from the console backend logs? metrics-bot: query-id=mx-7b3f, params={org_id: "acme", role: "manager", start: "2026-03-01", end: "2026-03-31"}

jess (eng-ml): pulling logs...

jess (eng-ml): root cause hypothesis: for linked orgs we store events under org_id = linked_org_id but TTL is set on primary_org_id. Our recent TTL change compared retention against event.org_id instead of event.primary_org_id, so events for managers in linked tenants are evaluated as expired and filtered out.

maria (support): if that's true, Admins would still see data because admin view uses a different aggregate path (global_aggregate) that bypasses the role-level filter, which matches customer report.

kevin (product): ok — impact: managers across a subset of linked orgs (those with retention overrides) will see missing data. Need mitigation steps and ETA for fix.

jess (eng-ml): mitigation: quick rollback of PR-1123 to restore previous TTL join semantics (uses primary_org_id) — that will stop new queries from excluding rows. For historical missing points we need a backfill job to recompute role-scoped aggregates for the last 90 days.

aj (eng-sre): I'll prepare a canary rollback to staging then prod. risk: low, affects query planner for metrics but we have fallback. scheduling: canary in 30m, full rollout in 2h if stable.

maria (support): ETA to customer? they asked for an interim workaround — any UI toggle we can recommend?

jess (eng-ml): temporary workaround: in the Console filter, pick role=All or use Admin impersonation (if they have admin) — not ideal. I'll also add an API flag /metrics?include_legacy_ttl=true we can enable for their org only; will fast-track a short-lived feature flag.

kevin (product): action items:
- aj: run canary rollback (30m) -> update thread
- jess: enable feature-flag for Acme to surface data while backfill runs
- maria/anna: notify customer with ETA and workaround
- jess: schedule backfill job and estimate runtime

jess (eng-ml): backfill estimate: ~6 hours for 90-day window for Acme (single org). If multiple orgs we can parallelize. Will post job id once queued.

aj (eng-sre): canary started. observing metrics now (query latency, error rate).

metrics-bot: canary-metrics: latency +2ms, error-rate unchanged, cpu +8% on metrics cluster

aj (eng-sre): canary looks stable after 12min, rolling to prod now.

maria (support): told Acme we expect visible improvement within 15–30 minutes of rollback, backfill will finish in ~6h. They acknowledged and appreciate the quick turnaround.

jess (eng-ml): prod rollback completed. Queued backfill job id=bf-20260317-881.

metrics-bot: backfill-job bf-20260317-881: started, estimated 6h

maria (support): Customer confirms managers now see charts populated for recent data range. Will monitor for any edge cases and ask them to report if they still see gaps.

kevin (product): postmortem checklist:
- root cause: TTL join used event.org_id instead of event.primary_org_id for linked orgs after PR-1123
- short-term fix: rollback PR-1123 and feature-flag to unmask data for affected orgs
- long-term fix: add unit/integration tests covering linked-org retention semantics + add e2e for role-scoped aggregates
- owner: jess (eng-ml) for fix and tests, aj (eng-sre) for rollout automation, maria (support) for customer comms

jess (eng-ml): I'll open the postmortem and PRs now. tagging followups in #postmortems once draft ready.

maria (support): thanks team :thumbsup:
